# Toolchain category contracts

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-contract-docs.js from packages/development/toolchain/categories/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Each tool category has a versioned capability contract. Commands and agents call capabilities by id (`<category>.<capability>`); adapters implement them. See the [adapter authoring guide](../../guides/adapter-authoring.md) to write an adapter and the [migration guide](../../guides/toolchain-migration.md) to move hardcoded tool references onto capabilities.
